messages:
incident-bot: ALERT 1745553333 - Canary anomaly: model-serving allocator mismatch detected for model:redwood-rev2 (weightset v2.1). High 5xx rate on canary pool :rotating_light:
incident-bot: Details: tokenizer/vocab mismatch observed in 12% of responses; shard affinity deviated from expected mapping. Auto-fallback attempted.
sre_jamie: @oncall-miguel seeing the same in dashboards, spike started ~3m ago. latency also up ~200ms on canary.
eng-tilly: pulling logs now, looks like allocator assigned v2.1 weightset to nodes expecting v2.0 shard map. probable publish race during promotion.
oncall-miguel: switching to mitigation plan A: remove canary from LB and flip rollback FF if customer impact > thresh. @pm-aaron any major customers on canary?
pm-aaron: quick check: two mid-market customers had requests routed through canary, but no escalations yet. CS on standby. @cust-success-liz can you ping them if we flip?
cust-success-liz: on it. I'll prep an outbound note if we do rollback.
eng-tilly: command to quarantine canary nodes:```sh
redwood ctl nodes drain --pool canary-rev2 --reason "allocator-mismatch"
```
sre_jamie: running drain now. also starting immediate KV-cache invalidation for canary prefix to avoid stale tokens.
oncall-miguel: feature flag kill-switch ready: `ff toggle rollout_weights_v2 --off --actor oncall-miguel` — will cut traffic to v2 variants. Do we want immediate toggle or forced rollback?
eng-tilly: toggle first, then do a full rollout rollback if toggling doesn't stabilize. toggle should be less disruptive.
incident-bot: ACTION logged: toggle rollout_weights_v2 OFF by oncall-miguel at 1745553458.
oncall-miguel: toggled. monitoring...
sre_jamie: errors dropping, latency trending down. still seeing sporadic tokenizer mis-encodings in ~1% of requests from cache. continuing cache flush.
eng-tilly: root cause summary so far: race in artifact promotion where allocator metadata propagation lagged behind weightset tagging. caused mismatched tokenizer/vocab to be served on some shards. config drift in allocator cache.
pm-aaron: timeline for rollback if needed? we can cut traffic back to v1 within 10m and do a controlled rollback to stable artifact.
oncall-miguel: preparing rollback command:```sh
redwood deploy rollback --model redwood-rev2 --to-tag stable-20260315 --reason "allocator mismatch"
```
cust-success-liz: customers notified: small blurb sent to two impacted accounts, monitoring for user reports.
sre_jamie: can we add a gating check to deployment pipeline to ensure allocator metadata version parity before promote?
eng-tilly: yes, will open a patch PR for a metadata parity check and a short TTL for allocator cache invalidation. low-risk.
oncall-miguel: closing incident when metrics stable for 30m. current status: canary drained, flag off, errors falling. will update post-mortem template. :white_check_mark:
